headline: Measles outbreak: Death toll reaches 1,108 as four die in 24 hours
summary: The number of fatalities from the ongoing measles outbreak has surpassed 1,100, with four new deaths reported in the last 24 hours. Health officials are urging increased vaccination efforts.
details: The measles outbreak in the country has claimed over 1,100 lives, with the latest figures indicating four deaths in the past 24 hours. This alarming rise in fatalities highlights the severity of the ongoing epidemic.

Health authorities are working to contain the spread of the highly contagious disease, which primarily affects young children. Efforts are focused on increasing vaccination rates and providing medical care to those infected.

Measles is a preventable disease through vaccination. Health experts emphasize the critical importance of timely immunization to protect vulnerable populations and curb the epidemic's devastating impact.

headline: Ex-major general arrested over attack on New Gini Properties
summary: Retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury was apprehended by the Detective Branch in Dhaka for his alleged involvement in an attack on a real estate firm.
details: Detectives have arrested retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury over an attack on New Gini Properties in Dhaka’s ECB Chattar.
He was arrested from a house in Segunbagicha under Ramna Thana around 2:45pm on Wednesday, according to Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Detective Branch chief Additional Commissioner Shafiqul Islam.
Mohiuddin Chowdhury is the fourth accused named in a case filed at the Cantonment Police Station on September 27.
The case includes charges of vandalism, looting, gunfire, and various sections of the Penal Code including attempt to murder.
Six other individuals have already been arrested by the Cantonment Police and the Detective Branch in connection with the attack.
caption:
A retired major general has been arrested in Dhaka for his alleged role in an attack on a real estate company.

Detectives have arrested retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury over an attack on New Gini Properties in Dhaka’s ECB Chattar.

He was arrested from a house in Segunbagicha under Ramna Thana around 2:45pm on Wednesday, according to Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Detective Branch chief Additional Commissioner Shafiqul Islam.

Mohiuddin Chowdhury is the fourth accused named in a case filed at the Cantonment Police Station on September 27.

The case includes charges of vandalism, looting, gunfire, and various sections of the Penal Code including attempt to murder.

Six other individuals have already been arrested by the Cantonment Police and the Detective Branch in connection with the attack.
